question: Who became the first Indian driver to win a Formula 2 race in May 2025?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Kush Maini**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kush Maini** became the **first Indian driver** to win a Formula 2 race in **May 2025**.
 
• Formula 2 is a **prestigious junior racing series** that serves as a stepping stone to Formula 1, the pinnacle of motorsport.
 
• Kush Maini is a **talented Indian racing driver** who has showcased his skills in various international racing championships.
 
• This victory marks a major milestone in Indian motorsport, as it highlights the rising talent in the country and boosts India's representation on the international racing stage.
 
• Kush Maini's achievement is expected to inspire other young Indian racers to aim for success in global motorsports.
 
• The victory showcases his dedication, skill, and potential to compete at the highest level of motorsport in the world.
 
• His win also brings recognition to India in the highly competitive world of Formula racing.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Arjun Maini**__

 __
 
• **Arjun Maini** is an Indian racing driver who has competed in various international racing competitions, including Formula 2 and endurance racing events.
 
• He is the older brother of Kush Maini and has represented India in motorsport on multiple occasions.
 
• Arjun has also participated in prestigious races such as the **24 Hours of Le Mans**.
 
 
 
• **Narain Karthikeyan**__
 __
 
• **Narain Karthikeyan** was the **first Indian driver in Formula 1**, making his debut in 2005 with the Jordan team.
 
• He has represented India in various motorsport events and is considered a pioneer in Indian motorsport history.
 
• Although a prominent figure, he did not compete in Formula 2 or win a Formula 2 race.
 
 
 
• **Jehan Daruvala**__
 
 
• **Jehan Daruvala** is another talented Indian Formula 2 driver who has achieved multiple podiums in the competition.
 
• He is part of the **Red Bull Junior Team** and is regarded as one of the most promising young drivers from India.
 
• Despite his impressive performances in Formula 2, Jehan Daruvala did not achieve a race victory in May 2025.
